prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original full-body sword cultivator for a 2D Chinese animated-fantasy game. Create ONE adult male wandering cultivator, in a readable three-quarter side view facing RIGHT. This is majestic guofeng mythology with deadpan, slightly absurd humor, conveyed through expressive acting rather than gag props. Match an animation-like art direction with confident flowing contours, bold teal/cinnabar/ivory color masses, simplified layered shapes, two- or three-step cel shading and restrained hand-painted accents. Not realistic concept painting, photography, CGI, or a baby mascot.

Character: a lean young adult with mildly exaggerated proportions, about six heads tall, long black hair tied in a high loose knot, one unruly hair tuft, angular expressive brows and lively eyes. Give him an alert, stubborn, faintly crooked confident smile: he looks nervous about facing a huge mythic opponent but absolutely refuses to admit it. A distinctive readable face, not a generic handsome expression. Keep adult anatomy coherent, with exactly two arms, two legs and natural hands.

Costume and pose: layered ivory and pale mineral-gray robes with broad simple folds, charcoal inner clothes and practical dark boots, jade-green trim, a cinnabar-red waist cord and wrist wraps. A modest wandering swordsman, not royal armor. Hold ONE straight Chinese sword naturally in the right hand, blade extending diagonally down toward the right; the whole hilt and blade tip must remain inside the frame. Left hand rests near the waist, ready but relaxed. Both feet are visible on one imaginary baseline. Body, outfit, face, hands and blade remain clearly separated, easy to animate later. No floating swords, weapons behind the head or exaggerated action effects.

Composition: ONE complete character, ONE standing pose only, centered full-body portrait on a perfectly flat saturated magenta background, RGB 255,0,255. The character including sword occupies at most eighty percent of the canvas, with empty safety margins on every side. Entire hair, hands, feet, robe edges and sword stay inside the frame. No magenta or purple on the character, no reflected magenta light. Bright readable lighting, crisp edge shapes, no skin pores or fabric microtextures. No scenery, floor, shadow, fire, aura, magic, smoke, particles, motion blur, typography, UI, labels, border, logo or watermark. Do not copy any recognizable modern game or film character.
